entities.name: Industrial Revolution
entities.label: EventWindow
entities.summary: The transition from agrarian economies to industrial manufacturing (c. 1760–1840), beginning in Britain. Steam power, textile factories, iron production, and railways transformed production, urbanized populations, and created the modern economic order.
